name: Reisen Udongein Inaba

introDialog.speaker: BOSS
introDialog.text: You think you can handle a Lunarian's illusions? Prepare to lose yourself in madness.

reimu.speaker: BOSS
reimu.text: The Hakurei shrine maiden? Let's see how your intuition handles moon-born lunacy.

reimu.speaker: PLAYER
reimu.text: You rabbits always have tricks, but I'll find the real one.

reimu.speaker: BOSS
reimu.text: Just try to keep your sense of reality, miko.

marisa.speaker: BOSS
marisa.text: A magician, huh? Think you can analyze my mind tricks?

marisa.speaker: PLAYER
marisa.text: Lasers can't solve insanity— I'll just dodge everything, dat's all!

marisa.speaker: BOSS
marisa.text: Good, I love a challenge! Let's see which of us unravels first.

sakuya.speaker: BOSS
sakuya.text: A maid of the Scarlet Devil Mansion? Care to experience a time-skipping lunar illusion?

sakuya.speaker: PLAYER
sakuya.text: You attempt to tamper with perception... but my sense of time is absolute.

sakuya.speaker: BOSS
sakuya.text: Absolute? We'll see about that one. Watch closely, or not at all!

sanae.speaker: BOSS
sanae.text: A wind priestess? Faith means little inside the moon's madness.

sanae.speaker: PLAYER
sanae.text: I... I feel dizzy just looking at you. Is this a spell or something else?

sanae.speaker: BOSS
sanae.text: Reality is what I make it. Try not to lose your way back.

reisen.speaker: BOSS
reisen.text: My own reflection? Now THIS is real lunacy...

reisen.speaker: PLAYER
reisen.text: If one of us goes mad, it won't be me this time!

reisen.speaker: BOSS
reisen.text: Then it's a contest of willpower—a true test of lunar resolve!

victoryDialog: It seems your mind is stronger than I'd imagined...
defeatDialog: You can't escape the moon's insanity.

victoryDialogByCharacter.reimu: Maybe the shrine's power does grant insight after all...
victoryDialogByCharacter.marisa: Laser focus outsmarted lunacy. Point to you!
victoryDialogByCharacter.sakuya: You cut right through the illusion. Impressive.
victoryDialogByCharacter.sanae: Faith in yourself is a curious defense against madness.
victoryDialogByCharacter.reisen: Even my own tricks can't fool me... this time.

defeatDialogByCharacter.reimu: Let's see your 'intuition' save you from endless hallucinations!
defeatDialogByCharacter.marisa: Magic doesn't help against losing your mind, does it?
defeatDialogByCharacter.sakuya: Even time manipulation can't outpace a delusion.
defeatDialogByCharacter.sanae: Prayer can't pierce a true lunar mirage.
defeatDialogByCharacter.reisen: Facing yourself is the hardest battle. You lose this round.
